title: Minimizable Action Pane (phone)
description: On a phone the action selection pane (the turn menu in the action phase) covers about 40% of the screen. It now has a 44 px chevron control (Minimize actions / Show actions, aria-expanded and aria-controls) that collapses it to one 48 px line, 'Your turn - choose an action', so the map stays visible and usable while the player decides. The preference is stored in localStorage (ti4_action_pane_minimized) and survives reloads; the pane expands once when the turn passes from another seat to the viewer, and whenever an error or a key-opened menu needs it. A fresh browser (nothing stored) always starts expanded. Desktop is unchanged: the control is hidden above 720 px. The before shots are taken on the base commit and committed; the after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- AY. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Before: 390x844, the pane cannot be put away
shots.caption: The turn menu covers the lower part of the board (about 340 px of 844). The map rows beneath it are unreachable until an action is chosen.

shots.heading: After: 390x844 expanded (default)
shots.caption: Same pane and buttons; the heading row gains the 44 px chevron (Minimize actions) at its right. About 3 px taller than before because the heading row is now as tall as the control.

shots.heading: After: 390x844 collapsed
shots.caption: One 48 px line above the Players and Events buttons: 'Your turn - choose an action' and the chevron (Show actions). The pane gave back about 294 px to the map.

shots.heading: Before: 360x740
shots.caption: On the smaller phone the pane covers nearly half of the screen.

shots.heading: After: 360x740 expanded
shots.caption: Same layout with the control; Players and Events stay clear below the pane.

shots.heading: After: 360x740 collapsed
shots.caption: The same 48 px line. The captures assert height <= 48 px, a toggle of at least 44 px, that Players and Events are not covered in either state, that the stored choice survives a reload and that expanding brings the buttons back.

shots.heading: Board area gained (390x844)
shots.caption: The visible board height above the pane grows from 172 px (expanded) to 466 px (collapsed), so systems can be inspected and selected while the menu is put away.
